one_line: A named parenting problem plus an unanswered warning in the first line, then the outcome line as the payoff.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down MeBook.ai envelope on a marble floor. Typed at the top: "POV:" and "אל תנסו לגמול את הילדים שלכם לפני שראיתם את זה ...", the same line in word subtitles and the voice (transcript). Book appears at 0:02.
q1_hook.why: It names a hot parent worry and withholds the answer ("before you have seen this"), a gap closed from 0:09 (H5, K6). Voice and text open together (H6, T3). Two text layers at once crowd a frame whose product is just an envelope (T2, S1).

beats.what: Top-down envelope on a marble floor; typed "POV:" warning; a book appears at 0:02
beats.why: A warning and a gap before any product detail

beats.what: Cover close-up, page flips, blank pages; "ביום אחד כבר שמעתם?", "שלוש", "משמעות."
beats.why: Book handled while the birthday-gift search is set up

beats.what: Hands put the book on paper to wrap it; "משהו קצת אחר שיעזור לי גם עם הגמילה שלהם"
beats.why: Gives the book its role in potty training

beats.what: Wrapping in blue, then pink paper, three static shots; "בחרתי" ... "ותוך דקה" "היה מוכן."
beats.why: The ease claim is voiced over wrapping, with nothing to back it

beats.what: Two wrapped gifts, then a toddler outdoors in string lights touches the pages; "הגיבורים."
beats.why: The first child reaction, 26 s in

beats.what: Top-down: a girl with a tiara headband, hand on a page; "כבר באותו לילה" ... "מוצץ."
beats.why: The outcome claim lands as the final word

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, send-worthy tip or ask to comment, share or save in the video or the caption.
q2_flow.why: The warning holds the first 9 s (H5). Then the middle sags: about 12 s of gift wrapping under the claim that the book took a minute, with no screen, photo or child to show it (R1, R3). The child reaction arrives late, and the pacifier line is the closing payoff (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video; the last subtitle is "מוצץ." (0:34). Caption line 1: "קוד קופון ספיר-10% הנחה". No comment word, question or link.
q3_cta.why: One ask only, a code with a real discount (C1, C2). It is the caption's first line, but the video never says or shows it, so a viewer won by the outcome line gets no cue to read the caption (C6).

q4_shown.what: MeBook.ai envelope 0:00-0:02; the cover with the child's name and "נפרד מהחיתול", page flips and blank pages 0:03-0:09; the book being wrapped 0:09-0:25, a QR label at 0:16; a toddler touching the pages outdoors 0:26-0:31; a girl with the book on a floor 0:32-0:34.
q4_shown.why: The book is handled within 4 s (S1), and the cover name is visible, but no photo of the child sits beside it (S2). A mother's first-person story with an outcome is real vouching (S6). The "one minute" order is said, not shown, and the book is under paper for 12 s (S8).

q5_edit.what: 12 shots in 34.8 s, about 2.9 s each. Hard cuts, no speed changes seen. Three static wrapping shots of 4.5 to 6 s. Word-by-word subtitles; single key words enlarged in yellow-green. Ends on the word "מוצץ."
q5_edit.why: Text from 0:00 and a change at 1.7 s are a good open (E1). Synced subtitles let it work muted (E4). The static wrapping shots add nothing new (R1). It ends on the payoff word with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: Potty training: a parent says a personalised birthday gift book helped her children leave diapers, with a result the same night. It serves parents at that stage and gift buyers.
q6_topic.why: Potty training is a live parent concern (K6), tied to a birthday gift (K7), and an idea worth sending to another parent (R5). "Already that night" is a strong result resting on one anecdote, so the claim is not modest (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down close-ups on a marble floor for the envelope and book; a static top-down shot of hands in a black sleeve wrapping the book on tile; a toddler outdoors in string lights; a top-down shot of a girl on a wooden floor.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the reader's seat and need no face (F5, S4), and a home floor looks native (H8). But while wrapping, the product is under paper (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: Typed headline near the top (about 30% down): "POV:" above "אל תנסו לגמול את הילדים שלכם לפני שראיתם את זה ..." (0:00-0:03). Word-by-word bold white subtitles with a black outline, about 75% down, key words enlarged in yellow-green: "הילדים" (0:01), "אחד" (0:04), "שלוש" (0:06), "בחרתי" (0:14), "לא" (0:26), "הגיבורים." (0:28), "מוצץ." (0:34).
q8_text.caption: "קוד קופון ספיר-10% הנחה". Three short lines: the code, "#תודו לי אחר כך", then four more hashtags (#mebook, #גמילה, #ילדים, #גמילהמחיתולים), some typed without spaces. No question, no product words, no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: A headline in the first second and synced subtitles work muted (T3, T1); the yellow keywords steer the eye (T2). But two text layers overlap at the start, the subtitles sit in the bottom 35%, and "POV:" starts a line in Latin (T2, T4, T6). Topic hashtags help search (T7); no Hebrew disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: 12 s of wrapping while the ease claim has no proof on screen; a result resting on one anecdote; two text layers at the start; no CTA in the video; no disclosure word; the book hidden under paper.
lumebook_takeaway: Warning hook with the book handled top-down, then a screen recording of the one-minute order instead of wrapping; close on the outcome line with the offer on screen.
not_verified: Whether the collaboration is paid; whether the book takes a minute to make; the children's ages and number; music. The transcript is garbled at 0:05-0:12, so only burned-in text is quoted. 720 x 1280 is the downloaded copy. The words between "הבת שלי ביקשה" and "מוצץ." at about 0:33 are not visible in the sampled frames. The reaction clips show a different setting from the wrapping; whether they show the same book is not established. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
